citation.description: All 9 enumerated scripts (check_verify_gate_parity.py:125-130, check_comment_hygiene.py:139-144, gen_env_registry.py:414-419, check_docs_index.py:436-441, check_readme_quickstart.py:452-457, gen_cli_reference.py:466-471, gen_mcp_reference.py:486-491, check_server_manifest.py:530-535, check_config_reads.py:561-566) each have an if-present guard with a log line naming the tree-skew cause.

criteria.criterion: Every gate step in `_build-and-test.yml` that runs a repo script carries the ee2a if-present guard, skipping with a log line naming the tree-skew cause.

citation.description: Both check_readme_quickstart.py (lines 209-214) and probe_rebar.py (lines 218-223) in the golden-path job carry the if-present guard with a log line.

criteria.criterion: The `golden-path` job in `gerrit-verify.yaml` is guarded the same way.

citation.description: test_present_script_is_invoked_and_its_failure_still_fails_the_build is parametrized over all GATE_STEPS; it stubs each script to exit non-zero and asserts the step both invokes it and propagates the failure.

criteria.criterion: A genuine gate violation still fails when the script IS present -- no gate is weakened.

citation.description: test_absent_script_does_not_fail_the_build (lines 186-194) asserts exit 0; test_absent_script_skip_is_explained_and_not_an_error (lines 197-210) asserts 'skipping' in output and no '::error::'. Both are parametrized over all GATE_STEPS collected from the live workflow YAML.

criteria.criterion: A test (mirroring `tests/unit/test_git_floor_gate_tree_skew.py`) executes each guarded step against a tree lacking the script and asserts it exits 0 without an `::error::`.

citation.description: test_patchset_lane_step_guards_every_repo_script_it_runs (lines 135-154) is a structural guard parametrized over all patchset-lane steps that runs a repo script; it fails on any unguarded script. test_the_sweep_finds_the_patchset_lane_steps (lines 121-132) is a vacuity assertion ensuring the detector matches at least 11 steps across both workflows.

criteria.criterion: Consider a structural guard: a check that FAILS when a step in the Verified lane runs a repo script without the if-present guard.
